scope: All21 known actual complete-car body intersections; exact cached historical OSM source versions on BOTH sides. This is tag classification, not surveyed terrain or proof of physical road elevation.
method: Group original42source edges by real shared source node. Compare all89exactwayversions, bridge/layer/tunnel/ground tags, sharedwayIDs, retained Overture source intervals, and exact per-edgearclength bindings where available. Packedheight is reported separately and never used as ground evidence.
